turns.q: How long will delivery take, roughly?
turns.replyTail:
Orders typically leave the warehouse within 2 business days. Once shipped:

Domestic Priority Shipping: 2 to 7 business days
U.S. Express Delivery: 1 to 2 business days
International delivery: 15 to 20 business days

These timeframes start from the shipment date, not the order date. Weather, holidays, and customs clearance can add time 💖
